ns2:section.sectionText: Summer KOR 201 course will be offered as an online course where students are required to study and practice the materials on their own and meet synchronously from 10 am to 12 pm (CST) on TR (2 days a week). This course will be offered in a flipped format and will provide a communicative learning environment through Zoom, KOR 201 Google Doc, Padlet, Quizlet , and Flipgrid. This course will be taught online using Canvas.
